findings.title: Missing viewport meta tag hampers mobile user engagement
findings.evidence:
Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/ via mobile_viewport_inspector [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (engagement-audit): Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/corporate/business-solutions/open-api/t-id/ via mobile_viewport_inspector [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (engagement-audit): Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/about/exchange/?internal_source=home_services via mobile_viewport_inspector [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (engagement-audit): Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/about/news/ via mobile_viewport_inspector [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (engagement-audit): Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/about/news/26012022-tinkoff-research-how-installment-and-loan-help-increase-average-check-by-40-percent/ via mobile_viewport_inspector [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Add responsive viewport meta tag to HTML head.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Insert <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"> into the document <head>.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves orientation by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: HTML <head> lacks <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">, causing mobile browsers to render desktop scale.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated high because the observed evidence indicates high impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No extractable answer on-site for "How much does Т‑Банк cost?"
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.tbank.ru/ via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-09-13T16:35:48Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Т‑Банк cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Make pricing extractable as text, not just as an image or a gated flow.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: State prices in plain HTML text and add Offer JSON-LD with price and priceCurrency. If pricing is genuinely quote-only, say so explicitly in text -- an assistant can cite "pricing is quote-based" but cannot cite silence.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves citation omission by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Т‑Банк cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any independent authority source
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.tbank.ru via onsite_identity_anchor_inspection [2026-09-13T16:35:48Z]: Across the crawled pages, Organization schema is present but declares 0 sameAs URIs, and 0 of 22 distinct outbound link domains point to an independent authority (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, GitHub, regulatory registries). No explicit independent-authority link was observed in the sampled pages; external corroboration was not searched. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable identity anchors linking the brand to independent authorities.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with a stable @id, legalName, and a sameAs array pointing to the brand's Wikidata item, Wikipedia article, LinkedIn company page and Crunchbase profile. Create those external profiles first if they do not exist -- sameAs pointing at nothing does not corroborate anything.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves corroboration by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: Across the crawled pages, Organization schema is present but declares 0 sameAs URIs, and 0 of 22 distinct outbound link domains point to an independent authority (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, GitHub, regulatory registries). No explicit independent-authority link was observed in the sampled pages; external corroboration was not searched.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No site search affordance found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.tbank.ru via search_affordance_detection [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: None of the 5 crawled pages expose a search input, a search form or role="search". A visitor who arrives on the wrong page from an AI answer has no way to find the right one without returning to the assistant. (Confidence: medium)

findings.title: No returning-visitor or account affordance detected
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.tbank.ru via returning_visitor_affordance_detection [2026-09-13T16:35:34Z]: Across 5 crawled pages there is no sign-in, account, saved-items or recently-viewed affordance in the visible text. Every visitor is therefore treated as anonymous and first-time, so nothing the brand already knows about a returning visitor can shape what they are shown. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Give returning visitors a way to be recognised, and use it.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an account or saved-state affordance appropriate to the site (sign-in, saved items, recently viewed, or a lightweight preference stored locally), then use it to surface relevant content on return rather than resetting every visitor to a cold start.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves personalization readiness by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

proactive_recommendations.title: Build third-party presence so Т‑Банк is resolvable away from its own domain
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Only 0 independent authority domain(s) are referenced from the crawled pages. Assistants weight facts that several unrelated sources agree on, and the major platforms draw on largely different source pools -- analyses of 2026 citation data find roughly 11% domain overlap between ChatGPT and Perplexity. A brand described only on its own site is a single fragile source no matter how well that site is built.

suggested_action.summary: Establish and maintain the brand on independent platforms, then link them via sameAs.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Create or claim a Wikidata item, a LinkedIn company page, and the profiles that matter in your sector (Crunchbase, GitHub, G2, industry registries). Keep the core facts identical across them, then reference them from Organization sameAs so the identity is machine-linkable.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add Article schema with author and dateModified to editorial pages
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 2 crawled page(s) are editorial or documentation content carrying no Article schema. Authorship and a machine-readable modification date are the signals assistants use to decide whether a passage is current and attributable -- without them, an assistant that finds a good answer on the page still has no basis to date it or credit it.

suggested_action.summary: Mark editorial and documentation pages with Article JSON-LD.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Article or TechArticle JSON-LD with headline, author (a Person or Organization with a real profile URL), datePublished and dateModified. Update dateModified when the content genuinely changes, not on every deploy.

proactive_recommendations.title: Declare a WebSite entity with SearchAction
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No WebSite schema was found. WebSite ties the domain to the brand entity and, with a potentialAction SearchAction, lets assistants point users straight into your own search instead of guessing at URLs. It is a small, stable addition that anchors everything else on the page to a named site.

suggested_action.summary: Add WebSite JSON-LD with a SearchAction pointing at your search endpoint.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add WebSite JSON-LD on the homepage with name, url, a publisher reference to your Organization @id, and potentialAction -> SearchAction with a target URL template.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add BreadcrumbList schema to deep pages
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 4 crawled page(s) sit two or more levels deep with no BreadcrumbList markup. Breadcrumbs give both a visitor arriving cold from an AI answer and the assistant itself the parent context a deep URL otherwise lacks.

suggested_action.summary: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD alongside visible breadcrumb navigation.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Emit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD listing each ancestor with position, name and item URL, and render the same trail visibly at the top of the page.

proactive_recommendations.title: Expose an agent-facing endpoint (NLWeb / MCP) built on existing structured data
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site already publishes structured data, which is the input NLWeb uses to serve a conversational endpoint that AI agents can query directly rather than scraping HTML. Because it builds on schema.org markup, sitemaps and feeds you already maintain, it is incremental rather than a rebuild, and it moves the brand from being read by agents to being queryable by them.

suggested_action.summary: Evaluate an NLWeb instance exposing an /ask and /mcp endpoint over existing content.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Point an NLWeb instance at your existing schema.org data and sitemap, and expose /ask and /mcp. Start with the content an agent is most likely to be asked about -- catalogue, docs, pricing.

proactive_recommendations.title: Consider publishing llms.txt, with realistic expectations
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No /llms.txt is published. Be aware this is a low-evidence convention rather than an established standard: 2026 measurements find major AI crawlers almost never request the file, and Google has stated it has no effect on Search or AI Overviews. It costs very little to publish and may matter if uptake improves, but it should be treated as optionality -- not as a substitute for the structured data and third-party presence that demonstrably drive citation today.

suggested_action.summary: Optionally publish /llms.txt, after the higher-leverage items above.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: If you publish one, keep it to a short markdown index of your canonical product, docs, pricing and company pages, and keep it in sync with the site. Do not deprioritise schema work for it.
